messages:
Carlos (infra): Hey team, need approval + quota increases for a new hybrid/private project: redwood-privnet-usw1. We need GPUs across regions and a few networking bumps. 

Details: requesting A100 (8x), H100 (4x), L4 (12x) in us-west1, and A100 (4x) in europe-west4. Also need external IP quota + VPC peering to partner-project-prod, and increase for 'In-use IP addresses' by 30. This is for Dedicated capacity rollout starting in 6 weeks.

Bob R: Can you paste the minimal justification we should send to GCP support? they'll ask usage patterns and start date.

Carlos (infra): Short version: "Production inference for Redwood Dedicated customers. Steady throughput (200-500 RPS aggregate), predictable low-latency SLOs. Reserved capacity for model serving; sustained GPU utilization expected 60-80%. Request supports initial cluster of 24 GPUs across two regions for canary + rollout."

Alice M: @Carlos (infra) please add billing account and indicate whether this is committed use or pay-as-you-go. Also who is the project owner?

Carlos (infra): Billing: billing-prod-01 attached. This will be under a 12-month reserved capacity contract (anticipated). Project owner: alice.m@redwood.ai.

Dana S: Networking: confirm we need VPC peering (not Shared VPC?), and whether Cloud NAT is required for egress. Also which subnets?

Carlos (infra): VPC peering to partner-project-prod to access private logging/metrics endpoints. We'll keep our own Shared VPC (redwood-shared-vpc). Need In-use IPs increased for ephemeral NATs for burst autoscaling. Subnets: us-west1-gpu-subnet and eu-west4-gpu-subnet.

Matt (eng-runtime): Also request increasing quota for 'TPU v4' to 0 (explicitly disable) and ensure H100 instances available (sometimes listed under accelerator type). We should include machine types: a2-megagpu-16g (for A100 80GB) and h1-32g? (confirm exact names in ticket).

Carlos (infra): Pasting gcloud snippet I'm planning to include in support ticket for clarity:

```
Project: redwood-privnet-usw1
Regions: us-west1 (A100 x8, H100 x4, L4 x12), europe-west4 (A100 x4)
Instance types: a2-highgpu-8g, a2-megagpu-16g, l4-highmem-8
Networking: VPC peering to partner-project-prod, increase In-use External IP quota by +30 in us-west1
Start date: 2026-05-10
Justification: Dedicated inference capacity for production customers, sustained utilization expected; reserved capacity contract signed.
```

Bob R: Looks good. Can infra-bot create the GCP support case and include the billing doc?

infra-bot: Created GCP support ticket: 1234567890. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/1234567890. Status: Pending GCP review. :white_check_mark:

Alice M: Added billing docs to the support case and looped legal for the contract copy. @Carlos (infra) can you add the expected monthly spend estimate? GCP will often ask that.

Carlos (infra): Estimated monthly spend (baseline reserved + burst): ~$85k/month for first quarter. I'll attach a breakdown in the ticket.

Dana S: Putting a quick network checklist here for the ticket so we don't miss items: 1) Increase In-use IPs +30 us-west1, 2) Allow routes for peering, 3) Open egress 443 to partner endpoints, 4) Confirm quotas for Cloud NAT connectors.

Matt (eng-runtime): One more ask: please request 'GPU driver/install' access for our infra automation service account (infra-sa@redwood.ai) so we can pre-bake images. Save us a second support round.

Carlos (infra): Good call — added. Will update this thread when GCP responds. Thanks everyone. :rocket:

infra-bot: GCP reply received (1799005880): "We can approve most GPU quotas in us-west1; pending validation for europe-west4 due to capacity limits. Please provide the commitment contract number for reserved instances."

Carlos (infra): Replying with contract ref: RDC-2026-045. Also opened a follow-up for europe-west4 capacity fallback to us-central1 if needed.

Bob R: Keep us posted. If europe-west4 can't be granted, let's prioritize us-west1+us-central1 to keep latency targets for NA customers.

Alice M: Approved from finance side for the estimated spend. Marking as green from my side.

Carlos (infra): Ticket updated, setting reminder to re-check in 48h. Thread closed for now but I'll post updates.
